{{Quote|I can look after myself.''"<br />"''One of your predecessors used exactly those words before he was shot in the back by a Corellian gunrunner.|PROXY, warning Juno Eclipse|<ref name="TFUn">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>}}
A '''gunrunner''' with a connection to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] lived sometime during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TFUn" /> By [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The [[Unidentified Rogue Shadow pilot|pilot]] of the ''[[Rogue Shadow]]'' was [[Death/Legends|killed]] before the events of [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''The Force Unleashed'' novel]], which according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' begin in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].</ref> the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|gunrunner]] shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] an [[Unidentified Rogue Shadow pilot|Imperial individual]] who was the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the ''[[Rogue Shadow]]'', the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] secret apprentice "[[Galen Marek|Starkiller]]." The apprentice's [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[PROXY]] would later tell the pilot's successor, [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]], about the incident with the gunrunner.<ref name="TFUn" />

==Behind the scenes==
The gunrunner was briefly mentioned in [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''The Force Unleashed'' novel]], which was written by [[Sean Williams]] and released in [[2008]].<ref name="TFUn" />
